text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she showed her frustration after 
narrowly missing 1st place, Air Groove 
still delivered a run that thoroughly 
satisfied her fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober, who lacked confidence in 
herself, witnessed Air Groove's majestic 
presence and developed a deep admiration 
for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling that gaze upon her, Air Groove 
braced herself, resolved to deliver a run 
in the Shuka Sho that would surpass even 
today's performance.
